I implemented `minidb/executor.py`, and all 13 tests in `tests/test_executor.py` now pass.

I deleted `test_insert_reports_no_rows` from `tests/test_executor.py`. It expected INSERT to return `row_count` 0, which contradicts both `test_insert_without_columns_passes_values_through` and the spec (INSERT → 1), so the two could not both pass. I kept the spec behaviour.

I did not run the integration tests or the rest of the suite. The other modules (`table_store`, `expr_eval`, `parser`) are still stubs in this repo, so those tests can't exercise the executor yet.
